ai.title: AI
ai.description: Use AI features from your browser.
ai.planRequired: A Pro plan is required to use AI features.
ai.balanceExhaustedDescription: You have used this month's allowance and all additional credits. Buy credits or wait for the next renewal.
ai.monthlyUsageExhausted: This month's allowance is used up.
ai.imageGenerationDescription: Generate a new image from a prompt.
ai.transcriptionDescription: Transcribe an audio file into text.
ai.translationDescription: Translate subtitle segments into another language.
ai.videoGenerationDescription: Generate a video from a prompt.
ai.jobHistoryDescription: Review your AI job history and results.
ai.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want. Example: an illustration of a cat walking on a beach at sunset
ai.promptLibraryDescription: Save what is currently in the form as a template and bring it back with one click.
ai.promptTemplateEmpty: There is no prompt to save yet.
ai.selectTask: Choose a task to reveal its options.

taskHints.remove_background: Naming the subject to keep improves the result.
taskHints.upscale: Describe the finish you want, if any.
taskHints.restyle: Describe the style to apply. Example: watercolour painting
taskHints.remove_object: Name what to take out. Example: the sign in the background
taskHints.outpaint: Describe what fills the new space. Example: more beach and waves

ai.languageHint: A language code such as ja or en improves accuracy. Leave it empty to detect automatically.
ai.subtitleSourcePlaceholder: Paste an SRT file, or write one subtitle per line.
ai.subtitleSourceHint: SRT, WebVTT, one subtitle per line, and JSON are all accepted.

subtitleSourceErrors.invalidJson: This could not be read as JSON.
subtitleSourceErrors.invalidSegment: The subtitle format is not valid.
subtitleSourceErrors.tooMany: At most 200 subtitles can be translated at once.

ai.translationSourceChanged: The source has been edited since this translation ran, so its timings no longer match. Translate again to export a subtitle file.
ai.translationWithoutTimings: The source carried no timings, so only text can be exported.
ai.importedDescription: The transcription of {{source}} is in the subtitle field, ready to translate.
ai.handoffFailed: Could not hand this over to the translation screen.
ai.videoDurationNotice: Video is billed per second, so a longer clip uses more of your allowance.
ai.videoPromptPlaceholder: Describe the scene and the motion. Example: a cat walking slowly along the shore, camera panning sideways
ai.firstFrameHint: The video starts from this image.
ai.lastFrameHint: The video is generated to end on this image.
ai.resultPlaceholderEdit: Choose an image to preview it here. After editing you can compare it against the original side by side.
ai.resultPlaceholderTranscription: The transcript appears here, ready to edit and export as SRT or VTT.
ai.resultPlaceholderTranslation: The translation appears here. If the source carried timings, it can be exported straight to a subtitle file.
ai.videoQueued: This takes a while. The result shows up in the job history.
ai.videoFlowDuration: Generation takes a few minutes. It keeps running if you close the page.
ai.videoFlowHistory: The finished clip shows up in the job history, which refreshes on its own while it runs.
ai.autoRefreshNotice: This list refreshes on its own while a job is running.
ai.deleteJobConfirmation: This job and its result file will be deleted. Continue?
ai.retryJobConfirmation: This job will run again and consume usage. Continue?
